tiers.name: unicode-invariant
tiers.definition: Behavior is defined by Unicode-pinned algorithms and should be invariant across human languages unless a later resource/profile layer says otherwise.
tiers.claimBoundary: Applies to implemented Unicode primitives and exact offset accounting only.
limitations: Unicode-invariant does not mean language-aware tokenization, morphology, parsing, or named-entity support.

tiers.name: fixture-proven
tiers.definition: Behavior is proven only for named frozen fixtures and their expected outputs.
tiers.claimBoundary: No behavior claim extends beyond the listed fixture slices.
limitations: The fixture set is intentionally small and not a language coverage benchmark.

tiers.name: resource-backed
tiers.definition: Behavior is backed by declared resources, licenses, provenance, and deterministic lookup rules.
tiers.claimBoundary: Current public resource proof is manifest/lookup behavior, not a broad multilingual resource registry.
limitations: Current resource fixtures are not a multilingual resource inventory.

tiers.name: comparator-backed
tiers.definition: Behavior or evidence has been compared against at least one named external tool/version.
tiers.claimBoundary: Comparator evidence is diagnostic and does not override the repository contract.
limitations: Comparator-backed does not mean agreement with every external toolkit or every language.

tiers.name: corpus-backed
tiers.definition: Behavior is backed by frozen corpus/document fixtures and expected aggregate outputs.
tiers.claimBoundary: Current corpus proof is explicit-token TF-IDF/BM25 over a small fixture corpus.
limitations: No broad multilingual corpus benchmark, IR relevance set, or large-corpus performance proof is implemented.
